mapper.select:
select fi.id, fi.create_user_id, fi.create_user_name, fi.create_time, fi.update_user_id, fi.update_user_name, fi.update_time, fi.version, fi.is_deleted, fi.warehouse_id, fi.asin, fi.msku, fi.fn_sku, fi.sku_no, fi.fbm_fulfillable_qty, fi.inbound_working_qty, fi.inbound_shipped_qty, fi.inbound_receiving_qty, fi.fulfillable_qty, fi.reserved_qty, fi.researching_qty, fi.unsellable_qty, fi.warehouse_name, fi.bill_date from fba_history_inventory fi where ${params.sqlMap.default} and is_deleted = false
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT id FROM fba_inventory f WHERE f.id = fi.id AND fi.fbm_fulfillable_qty = 0 AND fi.inbound_working_qty = 0 AND fi.inbound_shipped_qty = 0 AND fi.inbound_receiving_qty = 0 AND fi.fulfillable_qty = 0 AND fi.reserved_qty = 0 AND fi.researching_qty = 0 AND fi.unsellable_qty = 0)
ORDER BY fi.create_time DESC
